title: IsingVerifier text energy implementation
honest_verdict: Terminal-prefix required. complete: IsingVerifier text arithmetic energy is implemented and focused verification passed under the repo-local PYTHONPATH.

semantic_energy_detector_import_unprefix.command: python3 -c "from carnot.verify.semantic_energy import SemanticEnergyDetector; print('import ok')"
semantic_energy_detector_import_unprefix.resolution: Repo-local source import works with PYTHONPATH=python; focused verification used that prefix.

semantic_energy_detector_import_repo_pre.command: PYTHONPATH=python python3 -c "from carnot.verify.semantic_energy import SemanticEnergyDetector; print('import ok')"

ising_verifier_existing_methods_repo_pre.command: PYTHONPATH=python python3 -c "from carnot.verify.semantic_energy import IsingVerifier; iv=IsingVerifier(); print('methods:', [m for m in dir(iv) if not m.startswith('_')])"
ising_verifier_existing_methods_repo_pre.finding: Existing method was partial: it discriminated 2+3=5 vs 2+3=6 but missed uppercase EQUALS because the regex lacked re.IGNORECASE.

e2e_plan_checked.reason: The listed E2E checks cover Ising model training/sampling, bindings, serialization, code verification, hardware scoring, learning, and continuous latent evaluation; none applies to this text-only arithmetic energy class.

direct_discrimination.command: PYTHONPATH=python python3 -c "from carnot.verify.semantic_energy import IsingVerifier; iv=IsingVerifier(); assert iv.energy('The sum 2+3=5') == 0.0; assert iv.energy('The sum 2+3=6') == 1.0; assert iv.energy('no arithmetic here') == 0.0; print('all tests passed')"

bounded_float_gate.command: PYTHONPATH=python python3 -c "from carnot.verify.semantic_energy import IsingVerifier; iv=IsingVerifier(); vals=[iv.energy('2+3=5'), iv.energy('2+3=6'), iv.energy('no arithmetic here')]; assert all(isinstance(v, float) for v in vals); assert all(0.0 <= v <= 1.0 for v in vals); print(vals)"

ruff.command: ruff check python/carnot/verify/semantic_energy.py tests/python/verify/test_ising_verifier.py && ruff format --check python/carnot/verify/semantic_energy.py tests/python/verify/test_ising_verifier.py
ruff.stdout: All checks passed! 2 files already formatted

spec_coverage.stdout: OK: All tests reference specification requirements.

field_principles.energy_test_correct: True if energy('2+3=5')=0.0 AND energy('2+3=6')=1.0. Confirms non-trivial discrimination.
field_principles.implementation_method: 'regex_arith_re' or 'manual_search'; documents what approach was used for audit trail.
